changelog.title: What's new
changelog.subtitle: Every update, newest first.
changelog.r1000.1: Sell page: your listings on every retainer and everything you carry in one list, with one-click buttons on every row and the new price and why before anything is clicked
changelog.r1000.2: Rules: a sell list with a floor, ceiling, fixed price, lot size, keep count, listings to keep up and preferred retainer per item, category rules, a never-sell list, and vendor rules that stay off until you turn them on
changelog.r1000.3: Guarded pricing: Undercut or Match against same-quality listings only, never against your own retainers or your alts, with bait listings ignored, a floor from real sales and the vendor price, a step limit, a cooldown and price-war detection
changelog.r1000.4: Run now walks to a summoning bell, your inn room or a bell you pick and holds AutoRetainer back for the run
changelog.r1000.5: Every price is typed in the game's sell window, checked before Confirm and read back after, with a journal entry before each write; anything unclear stops the run and asks you
changelog.r1000.6: AutoRetainer: runs after each venture on the retainer it hands over and always hands it back, with a Sell now button, its protect list and your alts
changelog.r1000.7: Assist fills in the suggested price when you open a sell window yourself and leaves Confirm to you; buttons on the retainer list and the sell list start a run right there
changelog.r1000.8: Sources: your bags and crystals, and by choice a retainer's own inventory, the saddlebag and the armoury chest, never items in a gear set
changelog.r1000.9: The undercut watch checks your listings against Universalis on a timer with no game request; the Sell page shows every listing of every character
changelog.r1000.10: Sales: a ledger built from sale notices, the retainers' sale histories and listings gone between visits, with daily totals, a 30-day chart, hints and a CSV export without names
changelog.r1000.11: Returns a listing that sat below its floor for three days and vendors junk through a retainer, each only when you turn it on
changelog.r1000.12: Pause, resume and stop, auto-pause in duties, every run on the Sales page, the Console, a humanizer and a GM alert
changelog.r1000.13: Items you carry show their best price and what they could all sell for; click Market board or NPC on one, and set how many, the price and the retainer if you like
changelog.r1000.14: Every listing your retainers have up is undercut out of the box, never below its floor; turn it off in Settings, Pricing
changelog.r1000.15: Pick the bell runs use in Settings, General: the nearest one, your inn room, or the one you stand at
changelog.r1000.16: Opening a retainer's sell list yourself reads its listings into the plan, no run needed
changelog.r1000.17: Autopilot: Auto Seller goes to the bell on its own every hour, 2 hours or 4 hours while you are idle, or after each AutoRetainer venture, and stops when you move
changelog.r1010.1: Undercut: two identical listings on one retainer are told apart by their market slot, so neither is skipped as not found when the sell list shows them in another order
about.support.title: Made with love and care
about.support.body: This plugin is a one-person project, built in my free time because I love this game and its community. Keeping it updated takes a lot of those hours. If it has helped you, supporting me on Patreon or buying me a coffee means I can keep giving it that time. Thank you for being here.

about.reminder.title: A little reminder
about.facts.title: Did you know?
about.quotes.title: Words to live by
about.jokes.title: Just for fun
about.reminder.1: Been at it a while? Roll your shoulders and take one slow breath.
about.reminder.2: Hydration check. When did you last drink some water?
about.reminder.3: Blink a few times and let your eyes rest for a moment.
about.reminder.4: Stand up, stretch, and shake out your hands. Future you says thanks.
about.reminder.5: Sit up and settle in comfortably. Your back will thank you later.
about.reminder.6: Remember to eat something today. You matter more than any score.
about.reminder.7: Eyes feel tired? Look at something far away for twenty seconds.
about.reminder.8: Whatever you're chasing, you're allowed to take a break whenever.
about.reminder.9: You're doing great. Be a little kinder to yourself today.
about.reminder.10: A glass of water and a quick stretch can reset a long session.
about.reminder.11: Unclench your jaw and drop your shoulders. There you go.
about.reminder.12: Rest is part of the journey too. Step away whenever you need to.
about.facts.1: Honey never spoils. Jars over 3,000 years old have been found still edible.
about.facts.2: Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
about.facts.3: A day on Venus is longer than a whole year on Venus.
about.facts.4: Bananas are berries, but strawberries aren't.
about.facts.5: There are more possible chess games than atoms in the observable universe.
about.facts.6: Sharks have been around longer than trees have.
about.facts.7: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.
about.facts.8: Honeybees can recognize individual human faces.
about.facts.10: The Eiffel Tower can grow over 15 cm taller on a hot day.
about.facts.11: Hot water can sometimes freeze faster than cold water.
about.facts.12: A bolt of lightning is roughly five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
about.quotes.1: Done is better than perfect. You can always polish later.
about.quotes.2: Small steps every day add up to surprising distances.
about.quotes.3: Comparison is the thief of joy. Run your own race.
about.quotes.5: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
about.quotes.6: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
about.quotes.7: The best time to begin was yesterday. The second best is right now.
about.quotes.8: Celebrate the small wins. They count too.
about.quotes.10: Your only real competition is who you were yesterday.
about.jokes.1: Why don't scientists trust atoms? Because they make up everything.
about.jokes.2: I would tell you a chemistry joke, but I know I wouldn't get a reaction.
about.jokes.3: Why did the scarecrow win an award? He was outstanding in his field.
about.jokes.4: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. It's impossible to put down.
about.jokes.5: Why don't skeletons fight each other? They don't have the guts.
about.jokes.6: What do you call fake spaghetti? An impasta.
about.jokes.7: Why did the bicycle fall over? It was two tired.
about.jokes.8: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese.
about.jokes.9: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food, and I eat it.
about.jokes.10: I only know 25 letters of the alphabet. I don't know y.

safety.tabSub: Detects nearby Game Masters and reacts: stop the run, ping you, or take more drastic action.
safety.gm.stopRunHelp: End the run at once when a GM appears nearby. Strongly recommended; the other alerts are little use if the run keeps going.
safety.gm.toastHelp: Pop a Dalamud toast: "GM <name> is nearby!"

safety.gm.soundHelp: Plays a series of system beeps through your speakers. Loud enough to grab your attention if you're tabbed away.

safety.gm.commandsHelp: Chat commands to run when a GM is spotted. Useful for things like /logout, /sh stay calm, or a macro.
safety.gm.killHelp: Hard-terminate the game process via /xlkill. The last-resort option; no goodbyes, no cutscene, no logout. You'll get a disconnect.

humanizer.teleportHelp: Before each teleport the run casts.

rules.sell.footnote: Items in a gear set, equipped items and items AutoRetainer protects are never sold, whatever these rules say.
rules.sell.floorHelp: The lowest price per unit this item is ever listed at. Empty leaves the floor to the vendor price and the reference price.
rules.sell.ceilingHelp: The highest price per unit, used when competition is thin or absent. Empty means no ceiling.
rules.sell.fixedPriceHelp: List at this price per unit instead of the market price. The floor still applies.
rules.sell.lotSizeHelp: Units per listing. Empty lists whole stacks; a size such as 99 splits large stacks.
rules.sell.keepCountHelp: Units that always stay in your bags.
rules.sell.listingsToKeepUpHelp: How many listings of this item to keep up across all retainers, from 1 to 20. Each run tops them up from stock as they sell.
rules.sell.preferredRetainerHelp: The retainer this item goes to first when it has a free slot.

rules.sell.ceilingBelowFloor: The ceiling cannot be below the floor.

rules.cat.footnote: A category rule lists whole stacks, one listing per item and quality, and keeps nothing back. Use the sell list for anything that needs more control.
rules.cat.enabledHelp: A rule that is off matches nothing.
rules.cat.minimumHelp: Items whose reference price per unit is below this stay in your bags, so cheap materials are not listed by accident.

rules.vendor.junkThresholdHelp: A stack is junk when its reference value, for the whole stack, is below this.

rules.blocked.intro: Items in your bags that a rule matches but that will not be listed, and why.
rules.blocked.loggedOut: Log in to check your bags.
rules.blocked.none: Every matched item in your bags can be listed.
rules.reason.notMarketable: Not sold on the market board
rules.reason.belowCategoryMinimum: Reference price below the category minimum
rules.reason.qualityNotAllowed: Its rule does not cover this quality
rules.reason.noLot: Nothing left after the keep count and lot size
rules.hold.keptInBags: Kept in your bags by the keep count
rules.hold.belowLotSize: Less than one lot left after the keep count
rules.hold.listingsUp: Enough listings of it are up already
rules.hold.bagsFull: No free bag slot to take it out of the saddlebag
pricing.tabSub: How prices are chosen, how far one step may move them, and when a run holds back.
pricing.undercutAllHelp: Keep every listing your retainers have up the cheapest on the board, with or without an item rule. A listing never goes below its floor, and items on the never-sell list are left alone.
pricing.modeHelp: How a price is set against the lowest same-quality listing of another seller.
pricing.mode.undercutDetail: Go just below the lowest seller.
pricing.mode.matchDetail: List at the lowest seller's price.
pricing.undercutUnitHelp: A fixed amount of gil, or a percent of the lowest price rounded down. Never less than 1 gil.
pricing.unit.gilDetail: The same amount of gil for every item.
pricing.unit.percentDetail: A share of the lowest price, so dear items drop more.
pricing.undercutGilHelp: How many gil below the lowest seller a price goes, from 1 to 10,000.
pricing.undercutPercentHelp: How far below the lowest seller a price goes, from 0.1% to 10%.
pricing.referenceRatioHelp: Never list below this share of the reference price, the average of recent sales. The floor is never below the vendor price either.
pricing.baitRatioHelp: Ignore listings priced below this share of the reference price, so one troll listing does not set your price.
pricing.stepLimitHelp: The most one reprice may drop a price. A larger drop waits for your approval on the Sell page.
pricing.cooldownHelp: A listing is not repriced again until this long after its last reprice.
pricing.priceWarDropsHelp: Stop chasing a listing once it has dropped this many times inside the price war window, until the window passes.
pricing.priceWarWindowHelp: How far back the drops of a listing are counted.
pricing.raiseHelp: Raise a listing that sits far below the next seller, so it does not sell for less than the market pays.
pricing.raiseGapHelp: Raise only when the next seller is at least this much above your price.
pricing.maxRaiseHelp: The most one raise may add to a price. A listing below its floor is raised to the floor regardless.
pricing.belowFloorNewHelp: What happens to a new lot when the market price is below its floor.
pricing.belowFloorNew.keepDetail: Leave the lot in your bags until the market recovers.
pricing.belowFloorNew.listDetail: List the lot at its floor price anyway.
pricing.belowFloorListingHelp: What happens to a listing when the market stays below its floor.
pricing.belowFloorListing.keepDetail: Leave the listing at its price.
pricing.belowFloorListing.returnDetail: Take the listing back to the retainer once the market has stayed below its floor for 3 days.
pricing.maxRepricesHelp: A run stops repricing after this many reprices. 0 turns repricing off.
pricing.maxListingsHelp: A run stops listing after this many new listings. 0 turns new listings off.
sources.tabSub: Where the items to sell come from. Your bags and crystals are always read.
sources.saddlebagHelp: List items from your chocobo saddlebag. A stack is moved to your bags first, only when there is room and only for a lot already planned for a retainer.
sources.armouryHelp: List items from the armoury chest. Items in any gear set are never sold.
sources.retainerHelp: Sell items stored in this retainer's inventory, read while the retainer is open.
sources.noRetainers: Visit a summoning bell once so your retainers show up here.
sources.loggedOut: Log in to choose which retainers' inventories to sell from.
sources.retainersFootnote: A retainer's inventory is read only while that retainer is open, during a run or when you open it yourself.
autoRetainer.tabSub: Work alongside AutoRetainer when it is installed.
autoRetainer.postprocessHelp: When AutoRetainer finishes a retainer's venture, reprice and list on that retainer before handing it back.
autoRetainer.sellNowHelp: Add a button to AutoRetainer's retainer list that sends every retainer through Auto Seller.
autoRetainer.sellNowTooltip: Auto Seller: reprice and list on each retainer now
autoRetainer.sellNowUnavailable: Off while AutoRetainer is outdated or not answering
autoRetainer.alts: Treat AutoRetainer characters as my alts
autoRetainer.altsHelp: Never undercut listings from the retainers of your other characters that AutoRetainer knows.
autoRetainer.footnote: These need AutoRetainer installed and up to date. Items AutoRetainer protects are never sold or vendored, whatever these switches say.
autoRetainer.stateHelp: Whether AutoRetainer answers. Outdated means Auto Seller runs only from Run now and the Autopilot timer and does not hold AutoRetainer back.
autoRetainer.altsKnownHelp: Your other characters that AutoRetainer knows, and their retainers, read again each time the plan is built.
autoRetainer.jobHelp: What Auto Seller is doing in AutoRetainer's venture cycle.
autoRetainer.job.stoodDown: Stopped by you at this bell
autoRetainer.held: AutoRetainer is held back until the current run ends.
assist.tabSub: Help when you list by hand, and keep an eye on undercuts.
assist.enabledHelp: When you open the sell window yourself, compare prices and fill in the suggested price with its reason. You press Confirm.
assist.skipKeyHelp: Hold this key while the sell window opens to skip Assist for that window.
assist.watchIntervalHelp: Check your listings against Universalis on a timer and mark the undercut ones. No game request is made.
assist.onlyNeededHelp: The default of the Sell page's run option: a run visits only the retainers with an undercut listing, a lot to list or a listing to return.
assist.card.title: Assist
assist.card.typed: Typed {0}. Check it, then press Confirm yourself.
assist.card.belowFloor: {0} is below the floor, so nothing is typed.
assist.card.itemUnknown: Assist does not know this item from your bags or this retainer's listings, so the price is left to you.
assist.card.searchFailed: The price comparison did not finish, so nothing is typed. The Console has the details.
assist.card.skipHint: Hold {0} while a sell window opens to skip Assist.
buttons.runAllHelp: Start a run over your enabled retainers from this list: listings are repriced and lots listed within your floors and caps.
buttons.repriceRetainerHelp: Reprice and list for this retainer from its open sell list, within your floors and caps; the sell list stays open.
saleHistory.readHelp: Open each retainer's sale history on every visit and record its sales, so sales made while you were away are counted.
saleHistory.footnote: Sale notices in chat and listings that disappear between visits are recorded either way.
market.look.usage: Usage: /asell look <item id>. Open that item's sell window at a retainer first, or use /asell sendpath proxy to search at a summoning bell or a market board.
market.look.loggedOut: Log in before looking up market prices.
market.look.busy: A task is running; stop it before looking up market prices.
market.look.readingOff: Market listings cannot be read this session. /asell mbstatus says why.
market.look.notMarketable: Item {0} is not sold on the market board.
market.look.noSellWindow: Open the sell window of {0} at a retainer first, or use /asell sendpath proxy to search through the item search proxy.
market.look.otherItem: The open sell window holds another item. Open the sell window of {0} first.
market.look.noCompareButton: The Compare prices button of the sell window was not found this session. /asell sendpath proxy searches without it.
market.look.notAtMarket: Stand at a summoning bell or open a market board before searching for {0}.
market.look.throughSellWindow: Comparing prices for {0} through the sell window. The Console lists the price inputs when it is done.
market.look.throughProxy: Searching the market for {0} directly. The Console lists the price inputs when it is done.
market.look.failure.proxyUnavailable: the market search is not available
market.look.failure.requestRefused: the game did not take the search
market.look.failure.snapshotMismatch: the listings read did not add up
market.look.failure.readingOff: listings cannot be read this session
market.look.done.one: Read {0} listing of {1}. The Console has the price inputs.
market.look.done.other: Read {0} listings of {1}. The Console has the price inputs.
market.status.summary: Market: reading listings {0}, reading the retainer market {1}, writing prices {2}. The Console has the details.
market.sendPath.usage: Usage: /asell sendpath compare | proxy. /asell look searches currently go through {0}; runs and Assist always use the sell window.
market.sendPath.set: /asell look searches now go through {0}; runs and Assist always use the sell window.
market.sendPath.comparePrices: the Compare prices button of the sell window
market.sendPath.searchProxy: the item search proxy, at a summoning bell or a market board
market.historyPath.usage: Usage: /asell historypath window | packet. Retainer sale histories are currently read from {0}.
market.historyPath.set: Retainer sale histories are now read from {0}, from the next visit on.
market.historyPath.fallback: The data the game receives for the Sale History window cannot be read until its handler is found in game, so retainer sale histories are still read from {0}.
market.historyPath.packet: the data the game receives for the Sale History window
journal.damagedTitle: The journal needs a fresh start
journal.damagedBody: The journal of listing changes holds lines that cannot be trusted, so no price is written. Set it aside to start a fresh one; the old file is kept beside it.
journal.unreadableBody: The journal of listing changes could not be read, so no price is written. The Console has the details.
journal.setAsideFailed: The journal could not be set aside; the Console has the details.
journal.listTitle: Did this listing go up at {0}?
journal.returnTitle: Did this listing go back to the retainer?
journal.vendorTitle: Did the retainer sell this stack for {0}?
journal.body: A run could not confirm this change after pressing Confirm, so no price is written until you answer. If you are not sure, look at the retainer's sell list at a summoning bell.
journal.moveTitle: Did this stack move from the saddlebag to your bags?
journal.moveBody: A run could not confirm this move from the saddlebag, so nothing more is written until you answer. If you are not sure, look in your bags and your saddlebag.
journal.moveHintApplied: Your bags now hold the stack.
journal.moveHintNotApplied: Your bags hold no more of it than before.
journal.moveHintUnclear: Your bags changed by another amount, so they cannot tell.
journal.moveHintNoRead: Your bags could not be read to suggest the answer.
journal.hintApplied: A later read of {0} shows the change went through.
journal.hintNotApplied: A later read of {0} shows no change.
journal.hintUnclear: A later read of {0} cannot tell.
journal.hintNoRead: Open the sell list of {0} at a summoning bell and it is read to suggest the answer.
journal.answerFailed: The answer could not be written to the journal; the Console has the details. Set the journal aside to start a fresh one; the old file is kept beside it.
journal.damagedQuestion: The journal also holds lines that cannot be trusted. If your answer does not settle this question, set the journal aside to start a fresh one; the old file is kept beside it.
